what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Ethiopia, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 2378032 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 2378000.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia from 2020 to 2022, with the TPLF and GLF among the government's opponents, at war level in each of those years.
From 2023 to 2025 it records armed conflict over the government and over Amhara territory with Fano, also at war level, and armed conflict over Oromiya territory with the OLA from 2019 to 2025.
Floods, storms, earthquakes and mass movements are the disasters recorded for Ethiopia in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure peaked at 3851840 in 2022 and fell to 2378032 by the end of 2025.
New displacements from conflict were highest in 2021 in IDMC's records, in the same years as the war over the government.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
